name: DAIFUKU CO, LTD.
india_angle: Daifuku in India focuses on intralogistics and material handling solutions.
summary: Daifuku Co., Ltd. is a leading provider of automated material handling systems, specializing in solutions for semiconductor manufacturing cleanrooms. Their products, such as AMHS and OHT systems, are integral to cleanroom automation, ensuring efficient and reliable transport of semiconductor wafers and carriers.
